comment: Production build = the MongoDB backend only (dist/mongo/main.js). We scope `include` to the Mongo tree; tsc pulls in shared deps (common/*, modules/auth/jwt, config) via import-following. The legacy Postgres/Prisma path (src/app.ts, src/main.ts, src/modules/**, src/queue/**, src/common/audit.ts) is NOT included and is never compiled, so a generated Prisma client isn't required.
